t: A space chamber marks a volume that the Builder or Vehicle Builder can copy or move. Use chamber blocks and one controller to define the chamber.
空间方块标记出建筑机或载具建造机可复制或移动的体积范围。请使用空间方块与一个控制器共同定义该空间。
Sneak-right-click the controller with a Space Card to store its channel. Right-click the card in air to inspect chamber contents.
潜行右键点击控制器并手持空间卡，可保存其频道信息；在空中右键点击该空间卡，则可检视其所定义空间的内容。
Support Blocks are temporary helper blocks used by scans and builds. They are intentionally lightweight and can be cleared when no longer needed.
支撑块是在扫描与构建过程中使用的临时辅助方块。它们本身轻量化设计，无需时可随时清除。
